<analysis>LegacyQueryHelper is under an openrewrite exclusion, so the jakarta recipes never saw its fully qualified javax.persistence.EntityManager / Query. The script renames javax.persistence. to jakarta.persistence. in the case's files.</analysis>
<script>
import re

def error_files(p):
    """The case's files that still exist, in order, once each."""
    seen = []
    for e in p.errors:
        path = e.get("file")
        if path and path not in seen and p.exists(path):
            seen.append(path)
    return seen


def fix(p):
    for path in error_files(p):
        n = p.sub(path, r"\bjavax\.persistence\.", "jakarta.persistence.")
        p.log(f"{path}: javax.persistence -> jakarta.persistence ({n})" if n else f"{path}: nothing to change")
</script>
